title: Different terms and the three § 2-207 approaches
summary: The omission of “different” from subsection (2) leads the opinion to three competing solutions.
notes: Northrop canvasses knockout of both conflicting terms, retention of the offeror’s term after dropping the offeree’s, and treatment of different terms as additional terms under a materiality analysis. The court applies the first as its prediction of Illinois law, despite a stated preference for the third. Do not infer that the alternative preferred in dicta was the rule applied or that the buyer’s more generous warranty survived the knockout.
